definitions.short: a gerah or small weight (and coin)
definitions.full: H1626. gerah II. גֵּרָה noun feminine a weight, 20th part of shekel, gerah (Assyrian girû , Zehnpf BAS i. 506 ) — גֵּרָה Exod 30:13 4 t. — Only in definition of שֶׁקֶל , with number עֶשְׂרִים 30:13 ; Lev 27:25 ; Num 3:47 ; 18:16 ; Ezek 45:12 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1641 (as in 1625 ); properly, (like 1620 ) a kernel (round as if scraped ), i.e.
